content: Best practice for appointment scheduling: store timestamps as UTC (aware datetimes) plus the IANA timezone name (e.g. America/New_York) used at creation; convert to local time only at display/last step. DST transitions cause real bugs: a booking for a nonexistent local time (spring-forward gap) is handled inconsistently across libraries (shifted, error, or silently stored -> broken reminders); a job/reminder scheduled by local wall-clock time can fire twice or not at all across a fall-back/spring-forward boundary.
